turns.question: Of the returns of orders placed from August to October 2026, what share were returned as damaged?
turns.answer: The damaged-return share was 0.5 (50 % of returns had the reason damaged goods), counting returns on the returned order's date for orders placed 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z.
